content: Watch your thoughts as if they are clouds passing in the sky. Do not cling, do not push.
author: Osho
sourceWork: The Book of Secrets (Vigyana Bhairava Tantra)
story:
From the university lecture halls of Jabalpur to the bustling ashram in Pune, Osho challenged institutional dogmas, religious orthodoxies, and societal hypocrisies. Synthesizing Zen, Sufism, Tantra, and Western therapy, he introduced dynamic meditation techniques designed to shake modern individuals out of obsessive mental chatter into spontaneous, authentic aliveness.

This insight points directly back to the quiet center of being. Osho observed that while the mind perpetually scatters itself into past regrets and future anxieties, peace is only ever discovered by anchoring attention in the immediate truth of this moment.
reflectionPrompt: What would it feel like to release the need to control the outcome of the next hour?
